title: nte-character-toggle-menu
summary: Create or repair character-bound NTE outfit and accessory toggle menus. Mount on the owning character mesh/AnimBP rather than a world-global controller, save every selection immediately, reload saved choices after reconstruction, and reset only on the user's Reset click. Use for 人物挂载菜单、服装开关、避免干扰其他角色控件、点击自动保存. Not for intentionally global vehicle/tool dashboards.
